activity_summary: Between Aylesbury and Waddesdon you said the barley was to a man's knee, and that you would tell her the horse was dear when that was not why. You spoke a boy under a wall who must not answer too soon. You spoke no finished line. You meant to say the four words again before Grendon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke while walking, and kept the scene unfinished.

facets.activity: Spoke of the boy under the wall

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: She'll ask why I walked. I'll say the horse was dear

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That's the whole of it. She thinks she's alone

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I shall lose this before Grendon
